{{Short description|2000 single by Wyclef Jean featuring the Rock and Melky Sedeck}} {{About|the Wyclef Jean song|other songs with this title|It Doesn't Matter (disambiguation)#It Doesn't Matter}} {{Use dmy dates|date=June 2021}} {{Infobox song | name = It Doesn't Matter | cover = It Doesn't Matter.jpeg | alt = | type = single | artist = [[Wyclef Jean]] featuring [[Dwayne Johnson|The Rock]] and [[Melky Sedeck]] | album = [[The Ecleftic: 2 Sides II a Book]] | B-side = However You Want It | released = {{start date|2000|6|26|df=y}} | recorded = | studio = [[The Hit Factory]] (New York City) | genre = | length = 3:57 | label = [[Columbia Records|Columbia]] | writer = * Wyclef Jean * [[Jerry Duplessis]] * [[Ricky Walters]] * Andrew Long * [[Desmond Child]] * [[Draco Rosa|Robi Rosa]] * [[Taffy Danoff]] * William Danoff * [[John Denver]] | producer = * Wyclef Jean * Jerry "Wonder" Duplessis | chronology = [[Wyclef Jean]] | prev_title = [[New Day (Wyclef Jean song)|New Day]] | prev_year = 1999 | next_title = [[911 (Wyclef Jean song)|911]] | next_year = 2000 | misc = {{External music video|{{YouTube|VAag-nlCJQ0|"It Doesn't Matter"}}}} }} "'''It Doesn't Matter'''" is the first single released from Haitian rapper [[Wyclef Jean]]'s second studio album, ''[[The Ecleftic: 2 Sides II a Book]]'' (2000). Written by Jean and [[Jerry Duplessis]], the track features additional vocals from [[Melky Sedeck]] and wrestler [[Dwayne Johnson|The Rock]], whose famous catchphrase inspired the song title. The song includes samples of "Mona Lisa" by [[Slick Rick]], "This Is Ska" by Longsy D, "[[Livin' la Vida Loca]]" by [[Ricky Martin]], and "[[Take Me Home, Country Roads]]" by [[John Denver]], so all songwriters are given credits. Upon its release on 26 June 2000, the song reached number 80 on the US ''[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]'' [[Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Singles & Tracks]] chart. In September 2000, the song entered the [[UK Singles Chart]] at number three and spent 11 weeks in the top 100. "It Doesn't Matter" was also released in French under the title "Ça ne me fait rien" for [[Quebec]] and French radio stations, with Jacky and Ben-J providing additional vocals.
